name: workflow-canvas
title: WorkflowCanvas
description: An infinite (or bounded) pan-and-zoom workflow canvas with draggable nodes that render any content, side handles for drawing connections, and edges that follow their endpoint nodes — built to stay responsive with thousands of nodes.
